states.name: raw

states.name: deduped
states.description: DataFrame with redundant duplicate rows removed.

states.description: DataFrame indexed with custom single or primary key column.

states.description: DataFrame explicitly indexed with a DatetimeIndex for temporal processing.

states.description: DataFrame with hierarchical MultiIndex keys on rows or columns.

states.name: numeric_only
states.description: DataFrame restricted to float and integer numeric data dtypes.

states.name: dataframe_2d_generic
states.description: a fully numeric, non-null 2D tabular object, ready for array-like consumption

states.name: filtered
states.description: DataFrame subsetted via row conditions, boolean masks, or column selections.

states.name: grouped
states.description: Intermediate lazy GroupBy container partitioned by categorical or discrete keys.

states.name: aggregated
states.description: Condensed summary DataFrame resulting from grouping or reduction operations.

states.name: pivoted
states.description: Reshaped DataFrame transformed between long and wide formats.

states.description: Unpivoted long-format DataFrame with identifier and measurement columns.

states.name: merged
states.description: Combined DataFrame resulting from relational join or concatenation.

states.name: windowed

states.description: 1D labeled Series in unvalidated or unprocessed state.

states.description: 1D labeled Series with missing values or string defects resolved.

states.description: 1D labeled Series cast to numeric scalar values.

states.name: ndarray_generic

states.name: written_to_disk

states.description: Sink state indicating byte stream or buffer serialization.
